executive_summary: Eugenol exhibits highly favorable structural and spatial complementarity against the LasR Receptor ligand-binding domain, leading to efficient quorum sensing blockade and subsequent biofilm inhibition.
next_validation_steps: Perform micro-dilution biofilm assays against P. aeruginosa strain to evaluate biofilm inhibition kinetics.
Evaluate competitive displacement of standard autoinducer ligands from the LasR Receptor pocket using fluorescent assays.
Verify non-specific cytotoxicity limits against mammalian cell lines.
